goals.objective: Define versioned GameRecipeV1, operation taxonomy, rights-safe nutrition/provenance contracts, deterministic validators, Godot JSON and local SQLite exports, mutation scenario model, and migrate the current 50 published items into the isolated game-data corpus. Prove the public Web remains exactly 50 bilingual items and does not import game data. Complete independent review and quality gates.

goals.title: M13: Rights-safe 500+ game recipe corpus
goals.objective: Expand the commercial-ready isolated game corpus through audited milestones at 120, 250, and at least 500 items. Every exportable recipe must have quantified ingredients, provenance-backed nutrition, an acyclic atomic operation graph, applicable deterministic mutation coverage, allowed commercial usage decisions, independent review, and risk-equivalence sampling QA. Exclude unresolved high-risk content and keep Web publication at 50. After Cat Kitchen Goal 8 is merged, deliver a separate adapter proof without breaking existing replay.
